product_contract.authority: memory rows own only the current advisory dataset; conversation, tool, permission, Plan and external systems remain authoritative for current operational truth
product_contract.candidate_intake: one remember call prepares exactly one candidate and accepts it with the existing ToolResult transaction; even an explicit must-remember request cannot bypass governance
product_contract.governance: Host-scoped process-local best effort; the model may select only a sealed branch and cannot rewrite, split or merge the candidate statement
product_contract.duplicate_and_relation_settlement: ACTIVE exact duplicate has one partial-unique winner; plain duplicate skips deterministically; sealed SUPERSEDES or CONTRADICTS can use an exact existing source through APPLY_NEW_RELATION or CONFIRM_EXISTING_RELATION without overwriting producer or relation decision provenance; CONTRADICTS uses one canonical unordered identity and confirms the actual stored attribution in either endpoint direction; BASED_ON never backpatches a duplicate
product_contract.scope: USER facts become visible only inside the same memory domain after exact-origin governance; WORKSPACE facts remain inside the exact canonical project scope; relation reads filter both endpoints
product_contract.recall: one tokenizer-v2 contract serves indexing and query paths; private jieba HMM-disabled multilingual/code/path tokenization preserves negation, ordering terms and lexically expanded contractions while rejecting punctuation-only terms; compatible pgvector dense recall is optional and bounded; only explicit memory_search may invoke the optional qwen3-rerank provider; embedding and rerank accept only their dedicated credentials and all optional provider/enrichment failures remain advisory fallbacks
product_contract.compiler: MEMORY_RECALL and MEMORY_RESPONSE_PREFERENCE_HEAD are bounded untrusted append-only observations; each true ROOT user message starts one ENABLED/WRITE_DISABLED_BY_USER/ALL_DISABLED_BY_USER policy epoch, ordered steers may only strengthen it, model execution and local authorize/invoke exact-join the frozen policy, stable BASE_SYSTEM and tools never change, and installed messages are never rewritten
product_contract.preference_head: query-independent full replacement or minimal CLEARED/UNAVAILABLE invalidation read from one bounded repeatable-read fact/relation composite; no silent Top-N, summary or preference-specific durable projection
product_contract.anti_echo_and_sensitivity: exact-call model-visible provenance suppresses recalled-memory echo and repeated snapshots; sensitive USER_PROFILE is projected only for explicit relevance or safety/accuracy need
product_contract.weak_completion: wake, reflection, governance, embedding and rerank may be lost or remain incomplete without making conversation or accepted ToolResult fail

deterministic_verification.architecture_guards: all architecture guard nodes passed within full pytest; repository modularization delta targeted node passed in 1.27s
deterministic_verification.sparse_dense_hnsw: tokenizer/search trigger, compatible vector upsert, dense result and HNSW EXPLAIN path passed
deterministic_verification.strict_prefix: response-preference head and automatic recall are separate source heads; ALL_DISABLED appends CLEARED or no-op for both, WRITE_DISABLED keeps both visible, normal steers cannot weaken the current ROOT epoch, the next true ROOT user message resets policy, SYSTEM and tools remain equal, and messages only append a suffix
deterministic_verification.governance_faults: plain duplicate, exact existing-source relation in both CONTRADICTS endpoint directions, taxonomy correction, ACK-unknown confirmation, candidate/fact attribution, relation all-or-none, echo and scope fences passed
deterministic_verification.optional_retrieval_faults: main-model credentials never cross into embedding/rerank; provider construction and contradiction-enrichment failures preserve sparse/explicit advisory fallback without failing the conversation

real_provider_dogfood.database: fresh clean-v0 ephemeral PostgreSQL database force-dropped after each attempt; the user database was untouched
real_provider_dogfood.weak_completion_probe: an additional real-provider candidate was conservatively ABANDONED after strict governance output validation; no fact or embedding was written and the conversation still finalized normally

production_diff.counting_scope: git numstat under src and clients plus wc -l for untracked production Python files; dependency manifests, tests, documentation and machine evidence are excluded
